{{nihongo|'''Ita Shrine'''|井田神社 (沼津市)}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Izu Province]].

'''Ita Shrine''' (いたじんじゃ) is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|abstract|Q845945|ar|جينجا|arz|ضريح شنتو|bcl|Shinto shrine|ca|Jinja|cs|Šintoistická svatyně|da|Shinto-tempel|de|Shintō-Schrein|el|Σιντοϊστικό Ιερό|eo|Ŝintoa sanktejo|es|Jinja|eu|Jinja|fa|معبد شینتویی|fi|Šintolainen pyhäkkö|fr|Sanctuaire shinto|hi|शिंतो मंदिर|hr|Šintoistički hram|hu|Sintó szentély|id|Jinja|it|Jinja|ja|神社|ka|ძინძია|ko|신사 (신토)|lb|Shintō-Schräin|mr|शिंतो मंदिर|nl|Jinja (heiligdom)|no|Jinja|or|ଜିଞ୍ଜା|pl|Jinja|pt|Templo xintoísta|ru|Дзиндзя|sc|Jinja|simple|Shinto shrine|sl|Šintoistično svetišče|sr|Шинтоистички храм|sv|Jinja|th|ศาลเจ้าชินโต|tok|tomo sewi pi nasin sewi Sinto|tr|Şinto tapınağı|uk|Святилище (синто)|uz|Dzindzya|vi|Thần xã|wuu|神社|zh|神社|zh_yue|神社|qid=Q845945}} in Ida, {{ill|Numazu|Q241037|qid=Q241037}}, {{ill|Shizuoka Prefecture|Q131320|qid=Q131320}}<ref>[http://www.shizuoka-jinjacho.or.jp/shokai/jinja.php?id=4402127 井田神社] - 静岡県神社庁</ref>.

=== Overview ===
It stands in the eastern inland part of the Ida district, between {{ill|Cape Ose|Q11437688|qid=Q11437688}} and the Heda district / {{ill|Cape Mihama|Q11489198|qid=Q11489198}}.

Its founding is unknown, but it is an old shrine identified with the Shikinaisha of the same name, '''Ita Shrine''' (いたじんじゃ), and is also recorded in the ''{{ill|Izu no Kuni Shinkaichō|Q17193087|qid=Q17193087}}'' as "Junior Fourth Rank Upper, Ita no Myōjin"<ref name="gen">[https://genbu.net/data/izu/ita_title.htm 井田神社] - 玄松子</ref><ref name="engi">[http://engishiki.org/izu/bun/iz140305-01.html 井田神社] - 延喜式神社の調査</ref>.

In {{ill|1873|Q7757|qid=Q7757}} (Meiji 6), it was listed as a village shrine<ref name="engi"/>.
